entities.name: Arkbow
entities.description: Magical artifact attuned to Vivien Reid, holding an invocation of every creature that ever lived on Skalla and more.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: Planeswalker who possesses the Arkbow and summons spirit creatures by firing arrows.

entities.name: Skalla
entities.description: World whose creatures the Arkbow contains.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Draconic planeswalker who threatened their world.

events.summary: The Nura and Smaragdi created the Arkbow after their world came under threat from Nicol Bolas.
events.quote: The Arkbow was created by the Nura and Smaragdi after their world came under threat from Nicol Bolas

events.summary: The battle was lost and Vivien instinctively planeswalked to safety with the Arkbow.
events.quote: as the battle was lost, Vivien instinctively planeswalked to safety with the Arkbow

relations.quote: The Arkbow was created by the Nura and Smaragdi

relations.note: Possesses and is attuned to it.
relations.quote: in possession of, and attuned to, the planeswalker Vivien Reid
